serial_cost_policy.numeric_range: Finite integer-valued totals strictly below2^53 required for exact integer representation in existing binary64 aggregation. Overflow or totals>=2^53 -> UNRESOLVED_COST_NUMERIC_RANGE, no clipping or alternate aggregator.
